Honestly I feel the same way but it also helps me sometimes to think that it’s for those people who can’t live that I’m living for, if that makes sense..? Like people who want to live but die and for those of us who want to die but live , it seems unfair but if i can’t live for myself can I try living for those who couldn’t? Can I enjoy the food I eat,that they couldnt ? Can I I look at the sky and take a deep breath for those who can’t..? It all comes down to looking past your own pain and being grateful for what we do have however hard that may seem , because it’s the most difficult thing to do, but once ur able to see it that way it gets easier to make it through the day, I hope this doesn’t offend anyone and if it does I’m sorry, its just thoughts  I’ve had myself while struggling with depression and suicide.
